tagline: Helping you thrive in a changing world
hero_kpi_rationale: Full regulatory compliance achieved in 2025 for operational resilience (FCA, PRA and DORA), demonstrating the strength of systems and controls to minimize disruptions

kpis.name: Total operational losses
kpis.explanation: Total value of recorded operational risk events
kpis.description: Total value of operational risk events, primarily driven by provision revisions in the category of clients, products and business practices. Loss volume decreased by 10% despite the increase in value.
kpis.signal: Increase in operational losses due to provision revisions

kpis.name: Operational resilience compliance
kpis.explanation: Compliance with operational resilience regulatory requirements (FCA, PRA, DORA)
kpis.description: Compliance with operational resilience requirements set by the FCA and PRA, as well as material compliance with EU DORA requirements. Achieved by end of March 2025.
kpis.signal: Full compliance with critical regulatory frameworks in 2025

kpis.name: Material cybersecurity breaches
kpis.explanation: Number of material cybersecurity breaches over the past three years
kpis.description: NatWest Group has experienced no material cybersecurity breaches or associated material losses over the past three years, reflecting the effectiveness of layered security controls and defensive architecture.
kpis.signal: No material cybersecurity breaches in three years

ai_positioning.summary: NatWest Group actively uses AI to strengthen operational resilience, enhance controls, and scan the horizon for emerging risks
evidence: AI tools introduced to support control articulation and adequacy
Generative AI chatbots to support framework integration and horizon scanning
Assessment of inherent risks related to AI, quantum computing, and cloud adoption
